g.text: Does the BCA adjustment improve the same critic?

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636a

g.text: BCA-trained critics only | Same states, actions and own-policy reference for each pair | Final checkpoint

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: High-load fixed-band actions; smaller MAE is better. The strong-current, full-data seed 0 is a counterexample: 16.3 → 20.8.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: 21 ordinary / 32 strong-current anchor families per seed, with three correlated actions per anchor. This tests score adjustment, not policy-return causation.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: MAE = mean absolute error in discounted-return units; U = BCA uncertainty score. Source: authenticated report 55cae667d369.
